summary: Play or view files before cleanup, pick the best copy in each duplicate group, and swipe through labeled screenshots to Trash or keep.
introduced: Play / View — open photos and videos from Review Duplicates, Recommendations, Breakdown, and cleanup previews before anything moves to Trash
Review & choose best — Review Duplicates → Review & choose best lets you keep the suggested copy or tap Keep this on another, then send extras to Trash
Screenshot swipe review — Recommendations → Screenshots shows an on-device label and keep score; swipe left (or ←) to Trash, right to keep
changed: Screenshot detection — files named Screenshot / Screen Shot or stored in a Screenshots folder are classified during scan so they appear in that recommendation
Suggested keep in duplicate groups — ranking prefers favorites and richer copies over screenshots when choosing which file to keep
